name: Mrs Sippy
description: is a large, stylish pool club and restaurant in Seminyak, known for its massive lagoon-style pool, day-to-night atmosphere, and Mediterranean-inspired cuisine. It features a relaxed tropical vibe with sunbeds, a sports bar, and a Kids Corner, making it suitable for both adults and families. The venue is also popular for events and parties and has a history of hosting international DJs.
note: This place is famous for its day-party which typically runs from midday into the evening.
